identity.currently: Eddy Lin continues to work on his composition project for his college class at Oak Hill College, immersing himself in music theory and the exploration of diverse musical styles. He actively participates in collaborative projects and uses music as a therapeutic tool, regularly meeting with mentors like Dad to discuss stress management techniques.
identity.learned: Eddy Lin is a student at Oak Hill College studying music theory and composition. He loves to explore different musical styles and is always looking for ways to expand his knowledge.
